title: rosa multiflora var. adenochaeta
intro: Rosa multiflora var. adenochaeta, commonly known as the fragrant rose or climbing rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa multiflora var. adenochaeta include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which may help in alleviating symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
